paragraphs.markdown:
`--owner <path>`, `--case <slug>` and `--project <name>` narrow case-based phases;
`--implementation <id>` narrows their subject implementations. `discover` lists all cases.
From the repository root the same phases are reachable as `bun ./📜️script.ts test <phase>`, and every
case also has generated Nx targets (`test`, `test-quick`, `test-long`, `test-exhaustive`,
`test-contract`, `test-oracle`, `test-subject`, `test-parity`).

paragraphs.markdown:
Protocol v2 defines the full selector vocabulary — `--artifact`, `--standard`, `--subset`,
`--mutation`, `--outcome`, `--case`, `--fixture-class`, `--fixture-family`, `--oracle`, `--probe`,
`--implementation`, `--platform`, `--agent`, `--run`, `--status`.
Current `inventory`, `fixture`, `probe` and `matrix` commands consume relevant selectors;
ordinary `contract`, `oracle`, `subject`, `parity` and `run` use the case/subject selectors above.
The full coordinate is a reporting requirement, not a claim that every phase currently filters every
selector.

paragraphs.markdown:
Protocol v2 requires a case that compares more than one produced artifact, or needs a measured metric
rather than a structural JSON diff, to declare a `ComparisonPipeline` instead of a single
`ComparisonProfileSpec`: an ordered list of stages, each specifying one registered **probe** — an
external process or library that computes; the orchestrator is required to evaluate the typed JSON it
emits against declarative `<key>Max`/`<key>Min`/`<key>Equal`/bare-equality assertions, never computing a
metric itself. An unqualified probe stage declares `optional: true` and must still be run and reported,
but no release gate may claim its guarantee. Full detail, the assertion-lookup rules, the tolerance
formula, the coverage dimensions and a migration checklist for moving an owner onto this contract:
`.🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️27/SUBSET-SCOPED-EXTERNAL-ORACLE-MUTATION-TESTING/📓️protocol-v2-specification.md`.

The current generic `run`/`parity` route still uses projection profiles. Typed pipeline evaluation is
available as a library capability; generic stage execution and report collection are not yet wired
into that route.

paragraphs.markdown:
Protocol v2 requires atomic publication of a complete run directory. The current public run path
  still writes result/report files in place and adds a completion marker. A separate atomic-run helper
  is not wired into that path; its remove-then-rename sequence does not yet provide uninterrupted
  previous-or-new visibility.

preservedMarkdown:
Protocol **v2**. The unit of coverage is `artifact × standard × smallest owning subset × runtime
mutation × expected outcome class × fixture × subject implementation × platform` — never sharded or
reported at artifact level.

A runtime mutation is owned by the **smallest semantic subset**, never by an artifact-wide or `*`/`any`
wildcard scope — a cross-subset operation declares an explicit typed `compound` instead of falling
back to the whole artifact.

A second implementation written inside this repository from this
repository's own schemas is registered as `cross-semio-implementation` and is a required supplement,
never a substitute

The TypeScript host resolves the package from the repository's own `node_modules`
  instead of installing a private copy — one lockfile, one version of every library — and reports
  the declaration as unmet if it does not resolve.

An empty coverage denominator does not read as 100%. `matrix --enforce` fails a release-gated
  dimension explicitly when nothing was measured for it, rather than passing on the absence of data.

`gc` is dry by default everywhere it is offered; `--apply` is required to remove anything, and an
  `active` lease held by another agent, or a protected retention class, is never reclaimed regardless
  of age or size flags.
